summary.text: Gavin McGaughey is the Democratic candidate for the North Carolina House of Representatives, District 65, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces Republican Seth Woodall.
He has worked in manufacturing and earned a bachelor's degree from the University of North Carolina at Greensboro in 2025.

paragraphs.text: McGaughey graduated from Rockingham Early College High School and earned his bachelor's degree from UNC Greensboro in 2025.
In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, he said he attended Rockingham County public schools and has spent most of his working time in manufacturing and industrial construction.
McGaughey's survey responses name public school funding, workers and corporate taxation, and the cost of healthcare and prescription drugs as key messages.
He said that worker's rights are a policy area he is passionate about, and that he supports raising the minimum wage and empowering unions.
